jobs.title: Security Researcher
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise cybersecurity research / Red teaming Broad familiarity with enterprise security tools (e.g., firewalls, CASB, DLP, IAM, NDR, email security, vulnerability management), including what data/telemetry and configurations they expose and how they impact network security posture Working knowledge of network topology, enterprise architecture, and security best practices

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Requires 4+ years of experience. 4+ years in product management, with at least 2 cybersecurity products built Strong technical background to go deep with engineers on architecture and trade-offs Track record of products that practitioners kept using, measured by daily use
